sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:2

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:2:1
items.html:
AA [Arich Anpin], after he had been corrected through what Atik clarified in order to correct him — of itself, at the first time — raises the MAN to Atik: And you must remember what is explained in the previous part (page 626, the passage beginning “And Arich”; and page 725, operation 6), that before the Gadlut of the upper one came out, even the Ibur [impregnation] of the lower one could not come out. For at the time that the Katnut of Atik came out from the Rosh of SAG, the aspects of his AHP were flawed, because of the bottom Hey found in his Nikvey Einayim; and all the more so the degrees below his AHP, which are not fit at all for coupling. But after Atik rose to MAN [Mayin Nukvin] in the Rosh of SAG for the sake of the coupling of his Gadlut, and through the coupling of AB SAG the bottom Hey descended from his Einayim to the Peh, and his AHP returned to the aspect of a Rosh — then Atik raises to himself the aspects of the screen and the records of AA, and then was born the stature of the Katnut of AA, namely his aspects of GE, which are the aspect of the vessel of the Rosh, which is above the point of the restriction of his Nikvey Einayim, for the force of the restriction is not recognized at all above Bina, as above in the adjacent item. However, the AHP of AA are still in their flaw, for although the illumination of the coupling of AB SAG brought the bottom Hey down from the Einayim of Atik, this does not help AA at all, since he is a lower degree than Atik; and therefore the force of the restriction in his Nikvey Einayim is inferior to that of Atik, and the illumination of Atik is not sufficient for him. But after AA was born and corrected in his Katnut, then he returns and rises to MAN in Atik, and returns the AVI of Atik to face to face; for from the illumination of their coupling upon his MAN, the bottom Hey descends also from the Nikvey Einayim of AA, and his AHP too return in him to the aspect of a Rosh, and then he acquires the Mochin of Gadlut. Study it there well.
And this is what he said, that after AA was corrected at the first time through Atik, of itself. Namely, because of the Gadlut of Atik, which raises to himself the GE of the lower one, for being with him in one aspect (as above, page 626, the passage beginning “And Arich”). Then, at the second time, AA already rises by himself to attain his Gadlut, through the illumination of the coupling of the AVI of Atik, which brings the bottom Hey down from his Nikvey Einayim.
